# PowerPoint regression fixtures

`sample.ppt` (binary PowerPoint 97–2003), `sample.pptx`, `showcase.ppt` and
`encrypted.ppt` (upstream `sample-ppt-encrypted.ppt`) are synthetic regression
fixtures from [unStone/web-ppt](https://github.com/unStone/web-ppt), commit
`b41e9a5b65ce47bcc3e69edf6738f712a6b0b323`, under `fixtures/`.

Upstream Git blob hashes:

- sample.ppt: `6234c26bd2052c88cf58d5715556a106372ea20e`
- sample.pptx: `4ae5a91fdc0a47fdbd05f2859afb4e7398152294`
